step.action: Inspect the bag in 🍳 Wet_Trash_Bin for leaks.
step.ifThen: IF the bag leaks, THEN place it inside a second 🍳 Trash_Bags bag before moving it.

step.action: Put the closed bag inside 📦 Dumpster.
Install a new 🍳 Trash_Bags bag in 🍳 Wet_Trash_Bin.

passWhen.criterion: A new bag is installed in the wet-trash bin.
No wet waste or liquid remains in or around the bin.

reasoning.entry: Inspect before lifting so a leaking bag can be contained before liquid reaches the playa.
